newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei to announce earnings forecast revision.
newsitem.headline: Daiei to announce earnings forecast revision.

text.p: Daiei Inc said on Friday that it would announce a revision of its earnings forecast and sales of shareholdings after 3 p.m. (0600 GMT).
Daiei said earlier on Friday that it had sold off 20 billion yen worth of its shareholdings due to poor earnings in the current business year to March 31, 1997.
Daiei did not disclose its latest earnings forecast for the current fiscal year.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported that the company's parent current profit for the half year ended on August 31 would likely have declined 40 percent from a year earlier to slightly less than seven billion yen.
